classifier: Existing fixed HGB parameters, no model or parameter search
target: Unchanged: close after five observed quote sessions / signal close - 1 > 0.003
weights: Equal weight per signal date in training, calibration, regression and evaluation
cohort: Common complete feature/outcome rows shared by baseline and enriched arms; report exclusions
policy: Probability >= 0.6 AND predicted return > 0.003; unchanged across arms and periods
primary_screen: Later period: enriched paired date-Brier upper 95% delta below zero, date Brier beats past calibration constant, mean daily AUC >= 0.55, at least 100 policy rows on 20 dates, block lower 95% policy net-proxy return positive
uncertainty: 5000 paired circular resamples of five signal dates, seed 42; primary Brier contrast predeclared
evaluation_note: Historical development and later chronological audit, not claimed untouched final validation; current universe and retrospectively adjusted prices remain biased
new_information_note: Uses existing as-of OHLCV fields previously ignored. No present-day fundamentals backfilled into history. Volume*close is a liquidity proxy, not actual traded value.
